description: Public sources that the followed-source discovery workflow reads every run. Each source names what it is, why it is followed and its scope rules: sections, keywords and item exclusions with reason codes from CONTRIBUTING.md. Listed links become unreviewed leads in data/discoveries/leads/; a listing is never evidence for curation.
